column2: That bastard $$バアル$$! Wherever he is hiding, I will find him!!
Easy to say, but do you have any leads?
Yeah. While I was walking through that mansion, I saw what looked like an entrance to the basement.
The $$大邪神$$ armor may be down there too?!
But, $$お師匠さま$$, in that case there must be traps as well...
If you are scared, you needn't come along.
Wait. As wanted men, we have no way to survive against the Church alone.
Even if we split up, we cannot stand against the $$アンゲルス教団$$ and survive.
Unless we gain power, there will be no $$自由$$ for us!!
Yes... that is the truth of $$この世$$.
I do not want to die for nothing, but...
Unless we take a dangerous gamble, we cannot survive.
That is the kind of journey ours is...
